newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares advance on short trading day.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares advance on short trading day.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse ended the week in an upbeat mood as markets closed early for the long weekend. A recovery in Pharmacia & Upjohn after Thursday's heavy losses lent support to the market.
The all-share index closed 0.37 percent higher at 2,121.31 in turnover of 1.5 billion crowns. Many players elected to lie low after a hectic bourse week.

Pharmacia and Upjohn closed 7.50 crowns higher at 237 after Thursday's 13.50 crown fall in the wake of a fresh profit warning. However, analysts said they did not believe the share would rebound further and that the sell side was still strong.
Ericsson also showed strength after recent losses, the share gaining 5.50 crowns to 183.50 after a strong performance on Wall Street overnight.
Forestries remained weak, however. Stora fell 1.50 crowns of 84.50 and SCA lost 1.50 crowns to 136.50.
Hennes & Mauritz gained nine crowns to 880 after H&M president Stefan Persson told Reuters the company was taking market share on all markets.
"We're very pleased with the current period," Persson said.
